comments.regular: [Verified] bIsHDR is registered in INISettingCollection with setting name pointed to by bIsHDRSettingName: "bDoHighDynamicRange:BlurShaderHDR". The IDB's initial data byte is 1; startup initialization writes the active HDR-mode result to RendererGlobalState+0x1D7 only when this setting, bDoImageSpaceEffect, and the FP16ARGB blend capability are true. Fallout's Renderer::bHighDynamicRange similarly feeds its HDR manager flag; [Probable] these are conceptual counterparts, with different setting schemas.
